id_scheme: bq_{category}_{sha256(category|sorted(seed_chunk_ids)|question)[:12]}. Deterministic given identical inputs; NOT guaranteed identical across independent regenerations since LLM question text is not byte-deterministic across API calls. See docs/benchmark.md #5.
reference_answers: Automatically generated and automatically validated by an LLM judge (second pass). These are NOT human-annotated ground truth — see docs/benchmark.md 'Limitations'.
multi_document_necessity_validation: Automatically LLM-judged (checks that no single gold chunk alone fully answers the question). NOT human-annotated. See docs/benchmark.md #1.
unanswerable_validation: Automatically LLM-judged against the seed chunk plus the top-8 BM25-lexically-similar chunks in the whole corpus. Does NOT prove corpus-wide absence of evidence — see docs/benchmark.md #3.
gold_evidence_id_scheme: gold_chunk_ids computed via retrieval.identity.chunk_identity_key (the same function the production retrieval pipeline uses); gold_document_ids use metadata['document_id'] if present, else metadata['filename'] as a surrogate, since the committed faiss_metadata.json predates document_id being recorded.
